primaryChecks.text: Then Saul said to his servants, “Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her and inquire of her.” His servants said to him, “Behold, there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor.”
primaryChecks.previousContext: When Saul inquired of the LORD, the LORD didn’t answer him by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Saul disguised himself and put on other clothing, and went, he and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night. Then he said, “Please consult for me by the familiar spirit, and bring me up whomever I shall name to you.”
